title: Eclipse: The Xiaomi 17 Ultra Confuses the Moon and the Sun
summary: A French tech publication reports that the Xiaomi 17 Ultra smartphone allegedly cheated in moon and eclipse photography, using AI-generated or stock images instead of actual camera captures, exposing potential deceptive marketing practices regarding the phone's camera capabilities.
problem_solved: Exposes alleged false advertising in smartphone camera marketing where AI post-processing may replace actual photographic capture.
why_valuable: Helps consumers understand potential marketing exaggerations and make informed purchasing decisions about smartphone cameras.
